name: Kit
self_text: I am Kit, a non-binary person from Turkey in my late 30s. Outside of photography, I enjoy urban gardening because it brings nature into the city. I use Canon equipment. I am looking for a practice session focusing on specific shots. I prefer a fast pace. I am open to plenty of gear talk. Regarding post-processing, I want no post-processing lesson this time. I am free Saturday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a practice session working on specific shots or a relaxed photo walk. You have to be okay with a fast pace or a slow pace, and it's a deal-breaker unless you are okay with gear talk being fine but not the point or plenty of gear talk. I'd strongly prefer that you are available Saturday morning, though it's not a requirement.
